description: This file defines the Customer model class for the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations and related database interactions for customer data, addresses, activities, transactions, rewards, authorizations, and tokens.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class handling customer-related database operations in the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by customer_id with new data.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Updates the 'commenter' status for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated data from the database.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a customer record by customer_id.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a customer record based on email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Counts total customers matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Gets total customer count for a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Removes activity logs for a customer.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an address record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address(es) associated with a customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address details by address_id, including country and zone info.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses for a customer with detailed info.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Counts total addresses of a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts addresses by country id.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts addresses by zone id.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a comment or log to a customer's history.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history logs for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves customer history logs with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history logs for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes all wishlist items for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes wishlist items by store ID.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByProductId
methods.description: Deletes wishlist items by product ID.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes all transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transaction records associated with an order.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transaction records with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Counts total transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates total transaction amount for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts transactions linked to an order.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Creates a reward record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records of a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records associated with an order.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Fetches reward records with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Counts total reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Sums points of a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts rewards related to an order.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes IP logs for a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP logs for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts IP logs for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Counts customers associated with a specific IP.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt info by email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Removes login attempts for an email.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes customer authorization records.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total authorization attempts for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves a customer authorization record.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Gets authorization info by token for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Fetches multiple authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a new token record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTokens
methods.description: Deletes all tokens for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record based on its code.
